sections.Profile:
Alvin G. & Co. 's A.G. Soccer-Ball (1991) and its export variant A.G. Football (1992) are innovative pinball machines designed by Alvin Gottlieb, Jerry Armstrong, and Michael Gottlieb. These machines stand out as one of the few head-to-head pinball games, allowing two players to compete simultaneously from opposite sides of the playfield. Featuring six flippers, eight standup targets, and various kickers and spinning targets, this machine lacks traditional elements like pop bumpers and slingshots, emphasizing fast-paced, competitive gameplay.
